The petitioners who are residents of Dakshina Kannada District have called in question the correctness of the award passed under Section 3-G of the National Highways Act, 1956 ("the Act",
for short) and Section 29 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 dated 10.12.2020 and have also sought for direction in the nature of writ of mandamus to the first respondent to decide strictly in accordance with the Right to Fair NC: 2023:KHC:20444 Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
